_comment: File module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_binary_transfer_note: File transfer now uses binary WebSocket frames. Each chunk = 1 JSON metadata message + 1 binary frame. Group chunks by transfer_id; verify integrity with sha256 at the last chunk.
_sandbox_note: ALL file operations are restricted to the Agent's designated sandbox directory. Paths outside the sandbox are rejected by the Agent.

fs_list._desc: List files and folders inside a sandbox path

fs_get._desc: Download a file from the agent's sandbox. Agent responds with 1 JSON metadata message + 1 binary WebSocket frame per chunk.

fs_put._desc: Upload a file chunk to the agent's sandbox. Controller sends this JSON metadata immediately followed by a binary WebSocket frame with raw chunk bytes.

fs_list_result._desc: Directory listing returned by the agent

fs_get_result._desc: Metadata for the next binary WebSocket frame. Agent sends this JSON immediately followed by a binary frame containing raw chunk bytes (512KB per chunk, except possibly the last chunk).
fs_get_result.transfer_id: <uuid — used to group chunks; falls back to command_id if client did not provide one>

fs_put_result._desc: Agent acknowledges receipt of an upload chunk

fs_put_complete._desc: Agent confirms the full file has been received and saved, returning the calculated SHA256 checksum

fs_error._desc: Agent reports a file operation error (path outside sandbox, permission denied, timeout waiting for binary chunk, etc.)
